articles.title: Young workers most worried about AI affecting jobs, Randstad survey shows
articles.mainIdea: Young workers most worried about AI affecting jobs, Randstad survey shows
articles.summary: Reuters: Young workers most worried about AI affecting jobs, Randstad survey shows. Four in five workers believe artificial intelligence is going to impact their daily tasks at the workplace, with Gen Z ​among those most concerned as companies increasingly rely on AI chatbots ‌and automation, a survey conducted by Randstad showed on Tuesday. Job vacancies requiring "AI agent" skills have surged by ‌1,587%, Randstad said in its yearly "Workmonitor" report, with survey data suggesting that AI and automation are increasingly replacing low-complexity, transactional roles. Randstad, one of the world's largest recruitment agencies, surveyed 27,000 workers and 1,225 employers and covered more than 3 million job ⁠postings across 35 markets for ‌the report.
